promptPrefix: Surrealist fine art photograph, dreamlike and impossible, rendered with photographic realism but depicting something that cannot exist —
promptSuffix: The impossible element should feel completely natural within the frame. Render with the crisp, hyper-real quality of fine art photography — the surrealism comes from the subject matter, not degraded image quality.
variantDirectives: Wide frame, the figures small within the impossible scene:
Full-length frame, posture and gesture carry the strangeness:
Tight close-up, faces fill the frame:
Stark minimal composition, one calm light, nothing extra:
The impossible setting dominates the frame, the figures secondary:
Costume takes centre stage, the figures framed to show the clothes:

translations.real vs. impossible: the real and the impossible occupying the same frame
translations.waking vs. dreaming: waking logic pressed against dream logic in the same moment
translations.gravity vs. float: gravity abandoned and the body discovering what comes after
translations.inside vs. outside: inside and outside folded into the same space
translations.scaled vs. vast: human scale made absurd by the scale of everything else
translations.whole vs. fragmented: the whole self and the self in pieces at the same time
translations.visible vs. transparent: visible to some eyes and completely transparent to others
translations.time vs. still: time moving and time stopped in the same image
translations.organic vs. geometric: the organic form inside a world of impossible geometry
translations.self vs. mirror: the self and the mirror refusing to agree
translations.light vs. sourceless: light with no source and shadow with no object
translations.near vs. infinite: near enough to touch and infinite in every direction
translations.familiar vs. wrong: familiar in every detail and completely wrong
translations.solid vs. dissolving: solid in one moment and dissolving into the next
translations.one vs. many selves: one self and the many selves it contains
translations.memory vs. place: a memory that has become a physical place
translations.above vs. below reversed: above and below exchanging places quietly
translations.door vs. nowhere: a door that opens onto nothing and everything
translations.silence vs. impossible sound: the silence of an image that should be deafening
